## Notes

MECC, Apple II, autumn 1985; design led by R. Philip Bouchard; adjustable pace and rations; ford, caulk, or ferry river crossings; hunting with a 100-pound carry limit; party of five; banker, carpenter, or farmer; high scores and tombstones.
